name: Gust of Wind
description: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that ends its turn in the line must succeed on a Fortitude saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you and knocked Prone in a direction following the line. Any creature in the line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you. The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. As a Minor Action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the line blasts from you.
